name: DUET Solar System 360
summary:
DUET Solar System 360 shows school students what space is really like, with real distances, real textures and real missions.

- VR deep space: float inside a life-size Solar System and fly between the Sun, the planets and their moons.
- Mixed reality: see your own room with the Solar System floating in it, and walk around it.
- Every planet and major moon in 3D with NASA surface maps, with facts on size, distance, gravity, day length and temperature.
